title: The Singing Mine
rumor: The Singing Mine. Prospectors speak of an abandoned silver mine from which a low, mournful song can be heard at night. Those who enter claim that the walls themselves hum with music, growing louder as they descend. One miner returned carrying a fist-sized crystal that continued singing for three days before shattering.
first_lead: A disused mining trail beyond the Old Camp leads to the collapsed entrance.
